lines.trans: Yes, Mom, I am not at home.

words.gram: particle in the set phrase да ну

lines.trans: They called me in to work, an urgent banquet.
Alright, bye, Mom.
Well, are you ready to skate?
This turns out to be harder than I thought.
How is life, Denis?
Life did not work out.
And where are all the guests?
Is there nobody to work because of a hangover?
No, they closed the restaurant, they are going to film the chef.
We selected the most beautiful vegetables here.
Alright, got it.
Yes, Mom, I am not at home.

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: a large formal meal for many people

examples.text: У нас сегодня очень важный банкет.
examples.trans: We have a very important banquet today.
A lavish banquet was hosted in the restaurant.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.en: to call for, to summon (a taxi, driver, police, doctor)

examples.text: Ты же не помнишь ничего. Ты вызвал трезвого водителя!
examples.trans: You don't remember anything, after all. You called a sober driver!

examples.text: А где машинка? Где моя машинка?
examples.trans: Hey, where's the toy car? Where's my toy car?

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна, к вам гости! Па-пам!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, you have visitors! Ta-da!

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)
emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: The main thing is, you keep him at home.

examples.text: А Осипенко сейчас дома лежит. У него больное сердце.
examples.trans: And Osipenko is lying at home right now. He has a sick heart.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: A door, a shop, or a legal case.

examples.text: А потом, Аркадий Борисович, мы закроем ваше дело.
examples.trans: And then, Arkady Borisovich, we will close your case.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.en: to ride, to go for a ride

examples.text: Пока, ребята, я улетаю в Сочи кататься на лыжах!
examples.trans: Bye, guys, I'm flying to Sochi to go skiing!

examples.text: Красивая. Но это же не ваша жена! Я вашу жену видел.
examples.trans: She's pretty. But that's not your wife! I've seen your wife.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: We have nobody to fear here.
Is there nobody to work because everyone's hungover?
Of course, there's nobody else here to marry off.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: plant or part of plant used as food

examples.text: Там мне дают только чистить овощи.
examples.trans: There they only give me vegetables to peel.
Chop fresh vegetables for the salad.

оказываться.gloss: to turn out to be, prove to be

meanings.en: to turn out to be, prove to be, find oneself

examples.trans: Simple things turn out to be important.

examples.text: Иногда простые вещи оказываются самыми важными.
examples.trans: Sometimes simple things turn out to be the most important.
Oh sure, right now they'll take them away!

examples.text: Клавдия Викторовна, послушайте. Будете лезть не в своё дело, телевизоры отберём!
examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, listen. If you meddle in what's not your business, we'll take the TVs away!

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: У меня с утра дикое похмелье!
examples.trans: I have a wild hangover this morning!
Is there nobody to work because of a hangover?

related.gloss: to have a hair of the dog

meanings.note: работать + instrumental = to work as: работать мэром

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been working as mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.
Do you know the main thing?
Danila, let's go. Look, there's nothing complicated.

снимать.gloss: to take off; to film; to rent

examples.trans: Watch. I'm taking off my ring.

related.gloss: to take off; to film; to rent (pf)

examples.trans: This is a very urgent matter.

examples.text: Яков Григорьевич, у меня срочный вопрос к вам.
examples.trans: Yakov Grigoryevich, I have an urgent question for you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

увидеться.gloss: to see each other, meet up

examples.text: Послушай, мы сегодня увидимся вечером с тобой?
examples.trans: Listen, will we see each other this evening?
All right, see you in the kitchen, administrator!

meanings.en: to turn out well, to succeed, to manage (impersonal + dative)

examples.text: Я не поняла, как тебе это удалось.
examples.trans: I didn't understand how you managed that.
And did you manage to find a room?

meanings.note: in comparisons: больше, чем = more than

examples.text: А почему нет? Продавец получает больше, чем преподаватель.
examples.trans: Why not? A sales assistant earns more than a lecturer.

meanings.note: Informal. Borrowed from French 'chef' (head, leader, from Latin 'caput'); in Russian kitchen culture 'шеф' is the standard form of address for the executive head chef.

examples.trans: The chef is in the kitchen.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
